WITH audit_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_logs (
    event_name,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    actor_type,
    actor_id,
    result,
    before_payload,
    after_payload,
    metadata
  )
  VALUES (
    $1::text,
    $2::text,
    NULLIF($3::text, '')::bigint,
    'system',
    'n8n',
    $4::text,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($5::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb),
    COALESCE(NULLIF($6::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb),
    COALESCE(NULLIF($7::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)
  )
  RETURNING id
),
lead_update AS (
  UPDATE leads l
  SET
    lead_status_id = ls.id,
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM lead_statuses ls
  WHERE NULLIF($8::text, '') IS NOT NULL
    AND l.id = NULLIF($8::text, '')::bigint
    AND ls.code = 'error'
  RETURNING l.id
)
SELECT
  ai.id AS audit_id,
  lu.id AS updated_lead_id
FROM audit_insert ai
LEFT JOIN lead_update lu ON TRUE;
